steps.en: Install it and start it against your running Scrapyd server
steps.zh: 装好它，指向已在运行的 Scrapyd 启动

steps.en: In the web UI on :5000, create a project and upload your spider egg
steps.zh: 在 :5000 的网页里建项目，上传爬虫 egg 包

steps.en: Pushes the egg to Scrapyd and lists the spiders it contains
steps.zh: 把 egg 推给 Scrapyd，并列出其中的爬虫

steps.en: Add a periodic job: pick a spider and give it cron fields
steps.zh: 加一个周期任务：选爬虫，填 cron 时间

steps.en: At each due time, asks a Scrapyd server to start the spider
steps.zh: 到点就让一台 Scrapyd 启动这个爬虫

steps.en: Syncs job status back and shows running and finished jobs on the dashboard
steps.zh: 回收任务状态，在面板上列出运行中和已结束的任务

value.en: Scrapyd gets a click-to-deploy, cron-scheduling dashboard instead of curl calls to its JSON API
value.zh: Scrapyd 有了点一下就能部署、能按 cron 定时的面板，不用再 curl 它的 JSON 接口

sources: https://github.com/DormyMo/SpiderKeeper#readme (Installing: pip install spiderkeeper; Deployment: spiderkeeper --server=http://localhost:6800, port default 5000; Usage: create project, scrapyd-deploy --build-egg output.egg, upload egg)
SpiderKeeper/app/proxy/contrib/scrapy.py (addversion.json, listspiders.json, schedule.json, listjobs.json calls to Scrapyd)
